description: Log what your agent's model and tool calls cost, then get the running total for the run and for today. Pass events (one per call, up to 500) or an OpenTelemetry OTLP/JSON trace export as otel (gen_ai.usage.input_tokens / output_tokens / gen_ai.request.model are read; trace id becomes run_id). Give cost_usd per call, or tokens plus your own per-million prices; nothing is guessed. Optional caps: run_cap_usd and daily_cap_usd. Free watch-only returns would_alert when a cap is crossed; Pro posts one alert per day to alert_webhook. Never blocks or changes your agent.

alert_webhook.description: https URL Pro posts the cap alert to.

at.description: ISO time of the call (default now; at most 30 days back).

cost_usd.description: What the call cost, if your provider returns it. Otherwise pass tokens plus price_in_per_m / price_out_per_m.

model.description: Model name as your provider bills it.

price_in_per_m.description: Your input price in USD per 1M tokens (from your provider's price page).

price_out_per_m.description: Your output price in USD per 1M tokens.

price_in_per_m.description: Default input USD per 1M tokens for events without cost_usd.

name: log_costs
